In 2024, **12.8%** of children in Alberta lived in poverty. That is the latest year published. The measure is the Market Basket Measure (2023 base), which is Canada's official poverty line, applied to persons under 18.

Recent years on the same measure:

| Year | Rate |
|---|---|
| 2024 | 12.8% |
| 2023 | 11.9% |
| 2022 | 12.0% |
| 2021 | 8.1% (use with caution) |
| 2020 | 4.6% (use with caution) |

Other poverty lines, such as the Low Income Measure after tax, give different rates. I did not pull those.

Source: Statistics Canada, Table 11-10-0135-01, vector v1792632015, released 2026-04-29.
